visualCharacteristics.notes: Text-only 50/50 split: large uppercase headline left; body copy, footnote and two buttons (filled + outlined) right.

contentPattern.structure: one row: headline (h2) | body paragraphs + optional footnote paragraph starting with '*' + CTA links (bold link = primary, italic link = secondary)

suitableFor: page intro with headline beside body copy
notSuitableFor: short claim + single button bands (use columns-cta-band)
